audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits 46.78% WR: he bullies early with Rake poke and Q leap threat, Ryze flips at first item and outscales; level 6 is his roam spike.
Spikes (Lvl 3-5 Rune Prison vs Q dash, Lvl 6 Shadow Assault roams, 1st item flip, late outscale) accurate; 4 entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart disagreed with content/packet on rows 1-6; cooldowns field had no numbers; packet flags zero sequencing cues.
audit.why: Content and packet agree: Talon, Skill, Ryze, Skill, Talon, Ryze, Ryze. His W Rake is 9s rank 1, Q 8s, R 100/80/60; Ryze W 11s. Rune Prison stops his Q leap (dash).
audit.corrected: Full sides 1-6 moved to match content (side-only, win[] already agrees), whys rewritten, cooldown numbers and wait-for-Rake sequencing added.

edits.before: W online: the point-blank root answers anyone who closes. Trade Q-W-Q only when his engage tool is down.
edits.after: W online: the root answers his Q leap-in. Even window — trade Q-W-Q only when his W Rake boomerang is down.

edits.before: E unlocks the real combo: E-Q flux chunks and the wave-bounce clears. The lane starts being yours to play.
edits.after: E unlocks E-Q flux chunks, and Rune Prison stops his Q dash-in cold — the lane starts being yours to play.

edits.before: Tear + Lost Chapter and the EQ machine hums — short-trade his every wave contact and walk away before the answer.
edits.after: Tear + Lost Chapter hums, but his Q-W burst threat matches it — short-trade EQ above half HP and walk away.

edits.before: Realm Warp online — you are now a map play waiting to happen. The lane is a timer: shove and warp somewhere profitable.
edits.after: His Shadow Assault and wall-hops out-roam your warp — shove and ping MIA; a slow shove becomes a bot-lane double.

edits.before: RoA spike: your combo chunks half bars and your root starts kill chains. Force the trades you spent five levels avoiding.
edits.after: RoA spike: Q spam outscales his lethality poke and Rune Prison denies his 8s-cooldown Q leap — force the trades now.

edits.before: Two items and you ARE the win condition: EQ deletes carries, W stops divers, and Realm Warp turns objectives into ambushes.
edits.after: Two items and you outscale him outright: your pool eats his combo, EQ deletes carries, Realm Warp ambushes objectives.

edits.before: - Talon Rake: matchup-defining — The boomerang return is most of his lane damage — stand off the return line. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Rune Prison like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Talon W Rake: 9s at rank 1 — the boomerang return is most of his lane damage; stand off the return line. - His Q leap runs 8s — trade after a whiff. - Guard your W Rune Prison (11s) like a fifth summoner. - His R falls to 60s late — kill windows only.

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: A centered wave denies his E vault flanks — his W Rake runs 9s, so step up and trade in the window after it whiffs.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: At half HP his Q-W-melee combo with the Wound bleed kills you outright — the stack you greed is the one he cashes.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP is the map-game backbone. Nothing else is defensible on you.
